description: Directiva Inundații 2007/60/CE Ciclul II is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administraţia Naţională Apele Române. The European Directive 2007/60/EC on the assessment and management of flood risks, in short the Floods Directive 2007/60/EC, is one of the main pillars of European water legislation, together with the Water Framework Directive 2000/60/EC, and aims to reduce the risks and negative consequences of flooding in the Member States. Coverage: Administraţia Naţională Apele Române. The portal shows the English title as "Floods Directive 2007/60/EC Cycle II" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administraţia Naţională Apele Române. Its keywords include ape. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XML, PDF, ZIP, SHP. The listing shows 2025-02-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
